title: scamdown: take scam links down
lead: Got a scam text or e-mail? Paste it here. scamdown finds the host, the domain seller and the browser blocklists, and you report it to all of them in one go. Let's ruin their day.
placeholder: Paste the scam message, link or screenshot here
step1: Paste the scam message or a screenshot
step2: See where the link really goes and who keeps it online
step3: Report it everywhere with one press
none: No links found. Paste the whole message, or a screenshot of it.
gone: Already down. Nothing left to report.
copied: Text copied, paste it into the form
mailboxAsk: Send the e-mails too, from your own mailbox:
role.cdn: Proxy in front of the site
lost: Lost money? Call your bank first, then the police.
foot: Free and open source. No account, no name or e-mail needed. Nothing is sent until you press a button.
